text: 《大乘起信論》T1666（真谛译），含智愷序、卷首偈、迴向偈
classification_is: AI reconstruction (Claude), not human-audited; one class per unit by the brief order 甲>丙一>乙>戊>己>丁>庚, the second function in the note
commentary_sources: No 起信論 commentary is in the repository; the column is none except JS-041..044, where the correspondence of the four grades of 覺 to the four marks in reverse order is from memory of 法藏《義記》 and 元曉 (confidence lowered).
conventions: Enumeration headings (一者、X) and 問曰/何以故 frames are 庚; glossed list items (一者、X，謂Y) are 甲.
Similes are 庚, their law-shaped content noted; the application sentence carries the class.
Doctrinal theses of 唯心 are classed by their form (conditional → 丙一, identity → 未读出) and registered 定域, as §5.4 directs.
Path instructions, purposes and merit claims are 丁 (the whole 修行信心分 and 勸修利益分 are mostly 丁).

wu_units.form: 心自性清淨 / 無明所染
一切法常靜無起相 / 無明妄與法違
麁中之麁 屬凡夫境界
麁中之細、細中之麁 屬菩薩境界
細中之細 是佛境界
真如本一 / 無明無量差別
淨法熏習無有斷，盡於未來
真如自體相：無有增減，非前際生、非後際滅，畢竟常恒
心實不動 / 無明迷謂心為念
如來藏 唯有淨功德，不離不斷不異真如
染法 唯是妄有，未曾與如來藏相應

ji_units.form: 拒：三界外更有眾生始起
ji_units.note: rejects an absolute first arising of beings; plan answer: 生 is relative to a class, and a 無始 model simply has no 生 for that class

ji_units.form: 拒：五陰生滅自性實有；自性不生則無有滅
ji_units.note: rejects 生滅 as self-natured; plan answer: 生 and 亡 are relative to class, not 自性 (as for 中論, §一); the 不生則無滅 step is not a theorem of the grammar (an event can be 住 and later 亡)

weidu_reasons.reason: reason: says the name 真如 itself has no mark; the grammar has no operation for a term exempt from every predicate

reason: tetralemma over 有/無 and 一/異 (非有相、非無相、非非有相…); needs a negation of both and of neither that the grammar (constructive or classical) lacks; compare the plan's 非一非异 relative to classes (§一), which is not this
reason: 非可壞非不可壞 needs a both-negation the grammar lacks; 不離 readable as 相合; 心識之相皆是無明 is evaluative
reason: identity 色=心 needs a carrier that is mind; the grammar's 一 is not 心; registered 定域

most_important.line: 相續 := 無明: "念念相續未曾離念故，說無始無明": continuity is beginningless ignorance (reversal of the plan’s neutral 续; registered 反读)
四相俱時而有，皆無自立: synchronic; matches the plan’s 乙 (same event, several positions at once) only structurally
心起者無有初相可知: model property, no event is 生
究竟覺: knowing goes back through the four marks (滅→異→住→生) and finds no 初相; with JS-041..043
相續相 := 覺心起念相應不斷: nearest definitional match to 续 (linked, same kind, unbroken), as a mark of 不覺
相續識: carries past karma forward without loss and ripens future results: the plan’s 续 as carrier, valued as 妄
the aim is 滅相續心相
若無明滅相續則滅: conditional end of a continuation when its 缘 ends
the text’s own 续/灭 dilemma: 若心滅者，云何相續？若相續者，云何說究竟滅？
滅 := 唯心相滅，非心體滅: ceasing assigned to mark, not to 體 (相分)
以體不滅，心得相續: a second, non-ignorant sense of 相續, grounded in an unceasing 體; parallels 有常则续不尽 but with a substance
依一心法，有二種門: nondual form (相合), with JS-008 二門各總攝一切法 and JS-010 不相離
依如來藏故有生滅心; 不生不滅與生滅和合，非一非異: one-way 依 (相分 aspect) and the plan’s own 非一非异, applied to a different pair
染法…未曾與如來藏相應: no relation between 染 and 如來藏 (strong 相分), in tension with mutual 熏習 (JS-175, JS-178)
三界虛偽唯心所作，離心則無六塵境界: 唯心 scope (定域); one-way 境 依 心
心生則種種法生，心滅則種種法滅: 生/滅 of dharmas indexed by 心
差別 依 妄念: distinction is produced by deluded thought (strains 类 as neutral)
以眾生妄見境界故心有分齊: boundaries from deluded seeing
同相: vessels one under 微塵 (coarse class); with JS-107 異相 (fine): the two grains in the text itself
difference shown only 依業識: distinction relative to a reading
熏習 cycle 真如→無明→妄心→無明: a closed loop of mutual 缘 keeps 染法 going (with JS-168, JS-175/176)
染法 熏習 beginningless (no 生) but ends at 佛; JS-239 淨法 never ends: two asymmetric continuations
真如 非前際生、非後際滅、畢竟常恒: neither 生 nor 亡, as an unchanging substance
因緣具足乃得成辦: joint sufficiency of many 缘
觀 := 分別因緣生滅相, valued positively and paired with 止 (XX-090): the plan’s own activity has a place in the text

strains_with_plan.strain: 相續 belongs to 不覺 and 無明 and its ending is the goal; impermanence (念念生滅) is valued as 苦. The plan’s 续 is neutral. Registered 反读 as §5.4 says; no unit rejects that 相續 occurs, only its worth.

The text has a second, non-ignorant 相續: 心得相續 because 體不滅, and the 淨 continuation 無有斷，盡於未來. So the valuation is not of continuation as such but of which continuation; §5.4 should say "the 相續 of 念" rather than "相續". The ground given (an unceasing 體) is a substance, where the plan’s 有常则续不尽 rests on a class.

四相 are marks every thought has at once (俱時); they are 無自立 because all is 同一覺, not because position depends on a class. The four grades of 覺 know the marks in reverse and find 無初相: the 生 position is empty in this model. The plan’s use is a structural correspondence only, as §一 already says; the 乙 candidate JS-049 is proposed at low confidence.

The nondual 一心二門 (相合) sits beside a one-way ground (依如來藏故有生滅心) and the claim that 染法 never 相應 with 如來藏 (相分). JS-318 also strains the text’s own 熏習 (JS-175..179), where 真如 and 無明 condition each other. Registrations: 一心二門 相合; 如來藏/生滅心 相分 (asymmetry); 淨/染 相分.

strains_with_plan.plan: §一 中观之两难与本计划的回答
strains_with_plan.strain: 非一非異 is used here for the 和合 of 不生不滅 and 生滅 (阿梨耶識), not for two links of one 续. The plan’s answer borrows the phrase for a different pair; worth stating.

Differences (差別, 分齊) and names come from 妄念; the fine reading (異相) is 隨染幻差別; unity is in 真如. The plan treats every class as legitimate and finer classes as no worse than coarse; the text ranks them. Coarse/fine readings themselves (JS-104/107, JS-151/152) do appear in the text; the grains are ranked to kinds of knower (JS-153..155, 戊).
唯心 is registered 定域 as planned. Its dependence is one-way (境 依 心, 離心則無境界), where the plan’s 缘 may be mutual; JS-123 makes 生/滅 of all dharmas follow those of 心.

strains_with_plan.plan: §4.1 化与理, §5.4 本计划自己的一对
strains_with_plan.strain: 真如 有自體 and is 常恒不變, 無增減, neither 生 nor 滅; 滅 is only of 心相, never of 心體. This is the 金體/師子 shape inside the 起信論, against the plan’s 理 as a class among events. It adds a second text to the plan’s 理/事 registration.
境界緣 (the object as condition) is a main 缘 of the 六麁; the text’s 缘 often has the excluded object sense.
現識 appears 無有前後 and 熏習 forms cycles: co-present clusters (俱有), consistent with time as the strict part of 及.

The text rejects an absolute first arising of beings and 生滅 as self-natured, and in 止 says 念念不生、念念不滅. Plan answer: 生 and 亡 are relative to a class; but the text also holds 因緣和合，業果不失 (JS-366, XX-086) at the same time, which it places in practice (觀), a 定域 by 止/觀.

corpus_problems: No commentary on the 起信論 (法藏《義記》, 元曉, 慧遠) is in the repository; nothing could be checked against a commentary.
QXL-JS-090 reads 二者相續相 without 、 (file reading, harmless).
The 智愷 preface (14 units) is classified 庚 throughout; its authenticity is not addressed (manifest).
